item.text: {"issues":[{"description":"Users report being unable to sign in because the app will not accept their password or let them access their account.","issue_id":"I_ACCESS","issue_name":"Account sign-in problems"},{"description":"Users object to features such as song selection and playback being restricted to Premium, and to content or features becoming premium-only after updates.","issue_id":"I_BILLING","issue_name":"Premium feature restrictions"},{"description":"Users report missing songs, inconsistent lyrics availability, and unwanted recommendations.","issue_id":"I_CATALOG","issue_name":"Missing content and recommendations"},{"description":"Users report downloads getting stuck and offline listening not working.","issue_id":"I_DOWNLOADS","issue_name":"Download and offline listening failures"},{"description":"Users express general dissatisfaction with the app or its support and say they are uninstalling, without specifying a concrete product problem.","issue_id":"I_OTHER","issue_name":"General dissatisfaction"},{"description":"Users report playback and app reliability problems, including songs failing to start or stopping, crashes, loading issues, connectivity trouble, and controls that do not work properly.","issue_id":"I_PLAYBACK","issue_name":"Playback and app reliability problems"},{"description":"Users object to changes in playback controls, queueing, navigation, and frequent ads that interrupt listening.","issue_id":"I_USABILITY","issue_name":"Controls, navigation, and ad interruptions"}]}
